text_blocks.snippet: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) is a type of blood cancer that affects white blood cells called lymphocytes. It's the most common type of leukemia in the Western world and typically progresses slowly. Many people with CLL don't experience symptoms initially and are diagnosed during routine blood tests.
